KVUE.thesis_one_line: Maker of Tylenol and Listerine being bought by Kimberly-Clark for cash plus shares; the stock now just tracks the deal price.
KVUE.horizon: 3-6 months to deal close; 12-36 months only as a Kimberly-Clark holder
key_adverse_facts: Second Circuit vacated the Tylenol/acetaminophen MDL dismissal in July 2026 (10-Q acc. 0001944048-26-000142); liability not estimable.
Texas AG acetaminophen case on appeal; UK, Scotland and Australia talc claims outside J&J indemnity scope.
Goodwill 9,265 + intangibles 8,406 = 66% of consolidated total assets; tangible equity negative.
Gross spread to deal value only ~0.5%; upside capped, downside if deal breaks.
data_conflicts: Triage treated KVUE as pure merger arb with no primary-source work; filings confirm (HSR expired 4 Feb 2026, votes 29 Jan 2026, close expected Q4 2026) but triage omitted the July 2026 Tylenol appellate ruling.
KVUE.confidence_in_thesis: medium on deal mechanics (10-Q and releases); no numeric guidance exists; KMB not underwritten; next earnings date is a Yahoo estimate

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Standalone reverse DCF implies 3.2% 10-year FCF growth vs a 3.5% base, and the shares trade 0.5% below deal value of $17.90, so price is deal-anchored and there is no standalone edge.

KVUE.scenario_basis: Start $17.80, deal value $17.90 ($3.50 + 0.14625 x KMB $98.43); base = deal closes, combined company ~4% growth + ~5% dividend yield, flat multiple; bear = deal breaks/KMB de-rates to ~$14; bull = synergies and re-rating.
kill_criteria: KVUE trades more than 5% below (3.50 + 0.14625 x KMB close) for 5 consecutive sessions.
Any 8-K announcing termination of the Merger Agreement or a foreign-regulator block.
Quarterly organic sales growth below 0% in the Q3 2026 release.
Any accrual or judgment disclosed above $1.0bn for acetaminophen or talc matters.

SJM.thesis_one_line: Maker of Folgers coffee, Jif and Uncrustables, priced for shrinking cash flow although guidance was just raised; carries heavy debt and Hostess write-offs.
key_adverse_facts: Goodwill impairments of $1,661.6m in FY25 and $507.5m (plus trademark) in FY26 on Sweet Baked Snacks; FY26 GAAP EPS -$1.30.
~$0.60 of FY27 adjusted EPS guidance is one-off IEEPA tariff refunds; FY27 net sales guided down 1-2%.
Net debt ~$6.7bn, ~3.3x adjusted EBITDA (own estimate); maturities $150m Mar 2027, $500m Dec 2027, $750m Nov 2028.
Sweet Baked Snacks sales -7% in Q1 FY27 with 12.6% segment margin.
data_conflicts: Triage flagged 56.5x trailing P/E as a valuation problem; it is an impairment artefact and FY26 adjusted EPS was $9.15, FCF $1.2bn.
Triage cited weak ROE; GAAP ROE is depressed by non-cash impairments, not operating losses.
SJM.confidence_in_thesis: medium: guidance track record is reliable (FY26 inside range, FY27 raised) and valuation is undemanding, but leverage and structural volume pressure cap conviction; date is a Yahoo estimate

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF implies -2.4% 10-year FCF growth vs a +2.0% base, supporting a cheap-for-the-risk view.

SJM.scenario_basis: Start $121.00 and underlying FY27 EPS ~$10.15; base EPS ~$11.0 x 12x exit + ~$4.6/yr dividends; bear EPS $9.0 x 9.5x; bull EPS $12.5 x 13.5x.
kill_criteria: FY27 adjusted EPS guidance cut so that the underlying midpoint (ex the ~$0.60 refund benefit) falls below $9.90.
Consolidated net debt/adj. EBITDA (own calculation from 10-Q/10-K) above 3.75x.
Consolidated volume/mix negative in two consecutive quarterly releases.
Sweet Baked Snacks net sales down more than 10% y/y for two consecutive quarters, or any further impairment above $250m.

DGX.thesis_one_line: Largest US independent blood-testing lab, growing about 10% a year and raising guidance, but already priced for that growth.
key_adverse_facts: About 8 points of H1 2026 organic volume growth came from Corewell Health and Fresenius contracts; other volume grew ~4%; revenue per requisition -2.8% in Q2.
Adjusted operating margin 16.5% vs 16.9% in Q2 2026; GAAP 15.1% vs 15.9%.
Open inquiries: AMCA data breach state AGs, NJ USAO subpoenas, NY AG and Texas AG Medicaid billing, qui tam suits.
PAMA Medicare lab-fee cuts repeatedly delayed, not fixed; 2027 status not verified.
data_conflicts: Triage said price captures growth and did not note that revenue growth is ~10% with three consecutive guidance raises; filings confirm the valuation read but the execution is stronger than triage implied.
DGX.confidence_in_thesis: medium: clean execution and raised guidance vs priced-in growth at ~19.6x; date is a Yahoo estimate

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF implies 5.1% 10-year FCF growth vs a 6.0% base (within 1 pt), so price is full but not above base.

DGX.scenario_basis: Start $236.32, FY26 adjusted EPS midpoint $11.15, dividend $3.44 rising to ~$4.0; base NTM EPS ~$14.4 at Sep 2029 x 19x + ~$11 dividends; bear EPS $12.5 x 16x; bull EPS $16.0 x 21x.
kill_criteria: Organic requisition volume excluding Corewell and Fresenius below +2% for two consecutive quarters (currently ~+4%).
Adjusted operating margin below 15.0% in any quarter of a full year where revenue is guided up (H1 2026: 16.0%).
Full-year adjusted EPS guidance midpoint cut below $10.83 (the prior range top), i.e. erasing the last raise.
An enacted Medicare CLFS cut effective 2027 that the company estimates at more than $150m annual revenue.
